name: Zenith Twincast
effects: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking] to the user if the entry damage was Lightning/Fire/Ice, [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Palom (Lightning)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking] to the user if the entry damage was Lightning/Fire/Ice, [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Palom (Lightning)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Palom (Lightning)
description.text: Increases [Fire/Ice/Lightning Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Black Magic abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Palom (Lightning) after using three Black Magic abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Magic Barrage+
description.text: Five single attacks (3.80/3.95 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Palom (Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Buff Lightning 20% (15s)], [Buff Fire 20% (15s)], [Buff Ice 20% (15s)] and [Black Magic Quick Cast 3] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
